Hi Tom / Maria —

Thanks for sending the questionnaire. A few specific answers and helpers to speed your review: 

- Encryption at rest / KMS: Yes — Redwood encrypts customer data at rest using AES-256. Key management is handled via customer-specific keys in our KMS integration; for Hosted customers we support customer-managed keys (CMKs) via AWS KMS and GCP KMS; keys are never stored in plaintext and access is logged.

- SOC 2 coverage: Our current SOC 2 Type II report covers the hosted Redwood API surface (control environment, change management, incident response, availability). We can provide the SOC 2 summary report under NDA; I attached a one-page SOC2_Report_summary.pdf for initial review. Note: SOC 2 scope expansion (to include logging retention/access controls and identity providers) is on our security roadmap for Q4 2026.

- HIPAA / BAA: For customers with regulated PHI, we offer Private deployments with support for BAAs and additional contractual controls. Some enterprise customers also run in Dedicated (customer-isolated) environments with a BAA — happy to connect you with our compliance team for details.

- Vendor questionnaire: We can complete the VSA directly (we typically return a marked-up PDF + supporting evidence links). To streamline, please confirm whether you prefer a completed PDF or a secure link to our evidence bundle.

Proposed next steps: 
1) FinCo confirms preferred submission format for the questionnaire.
2) Redwood to return completed VSA + SOC2 summary within 3 business days of format confirmation.
3) If FinCo needs HIPAA covered in hosted mode, schedule a call with our compliance lead to discuss Private/Dedicated options and BAA terms.

Happy to jump on a quick 30-min call — available Tue/Wed this week 10:00–14:00 PT.

Regards,
